title: nepal-date-kit calendar data
description: Month lengths and Gregorian anchors for Bikram Sambat conversion. This document has no holidays, festivals, tithi, or events. The JSON Schema checks the shape. validateCalendarData() in nepal-date-kit also checks that years are contiguous and that each adStartOfYear is the day after the previous year ends.

source.description: Where the month lengths came from.

unverifiedYears.description: Note for years after verifiedThrough. Not a machine range.

anchor.description: First supported BS day and the matching Gregorian day. anchor.bs is always YYYY-01-01 of the earliest year, and anchor.ad equals that year's adStartOfYear.

bs.description: BS date of 1 Baishakh of the earliest year.

ad.description: Gregorian date of that BS day, YYYY-MM-DD.

verifiedThrough.description: Last BS year whose lengths have been checked. Must be one of the years in this document. Later years still convert.

years.description: Map of BS year to month lengths. Keys must be contiguous four-digit years.

months.description: Day counts for Baishakh, Jestha, Aashadha, Shrawan, Bhadra, Ashwin, Kartik, Mangsir, Paush, Magh, Falgun, and Chaitra.

adStartOfYear.description: Gregorian date of 1 Baishakh for this BS year.
